items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Mario Minera was the one who taught you to music? Yeah, he taught me. And he was the one who gave me the first job.

ctx.x: You were faking them? Yeah. He would teach you the numbers of the band you played with?

Yeah, well I was quick on that. I would always follow them. I didn't care what they played. I knew it was progressive pretty well. I was having trouble. That's another thing that they liked. Anything they played, most likely I could play whether I knew it or not, it was progressive, unless it was a difficult number like Body and Soul or something like that. But you did learn some songs from music. Oh, getting to your eyes, numbers like that, I might have to hear the music, but just a little round number,…
I know they gave you this job.
